atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production mouth-animation sprite atlas, 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, 12 cells total, transparent PNG.
Input images: Image 1 is Marju's character anchor and the mandatory identity/style reference; Image 2 is only the 12 mouth-pose layout reference. Do NOT copy the red graphic mouth style or labels from image 2.
Primary request: render twelve different speech mouth shapes belonging to the SAME natural adult character from image 1. Each tile contains ONLY a small rectangular patch of peach skin with the mouth centered in it, no nose, chin, eyes, hair or face outline. Match image 1's thin natural pink lips, softly painted texture and lighting. Same scale, perspective and mouth center in every tile. The mouth line slopes slightly downward toward image-right, matching her tilted face in image 1. Do not straighten its angle.
Composition: horizontal atlas overall aspect 7:3, 4 columns x3 rows. Twelve equal rectangular cells each aspect 7:4; every patch fills its own cell, softly fading to transparent near cell edges. Mouth width normally about 75% of tile width, varies naturally by pose; surrounding skin about 15% padding. Identical per-cell alignment. No gaps or visible borders; real transparent background outside softly edged skin patches. No labels, letters, numbers, watermark, grid lines or additional parts.
Cells LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM exactly:
1 A/E/I: open broad vowel mouth, both upper teeth and dark inner mouth visible, not a huge smile.
2 O: vertically open rounded oval lips, narrower than shape 1.
3 U: small puckered lips, very narrow round opening.
4 C/D/N/S/T/X/Y/Z: lips wide and slightly parted with teeth nearly together, narrow teeth strip.
5 G/K: medium open mouth with darker back interior and lower tongue visible.
6 L: medium open mouth, tongue tip raised toward upper front teeth.
7 B/M/P: lips firmly together, closed, neither smile nor opening.
8 F/V: upper front teeth touching lower lip, not merely smiling.
9 EE: horizontally stretched lips, narrow opening with teeth visible.
10 T/H: mouth parted, tongue tip visible at the front between teeth.
11 CH/J/SH: lips slightly pushed forward with medium small opening and teeth nearly together.
12 Q/W: rounded puckered lips with small round opening, more open than U and narrower than O.
Constraints: all are subtle realistic speech poses, not exaggerated red cartoon symbols, consistent lip color and skin tone across all12. Exactly twelve tiles in specified order. This is an atlas, not a complete character or reference chart.

Asset type: full-frame speaking mouth source variant of Marju's seated character anchor.
Input image 1 is exact edit target and framing reference.

Upper lip raised slightly so the front teeth are visible. This must be a lip-biting speech articulation, NOT a smile with both rows of teeth together. Very small opening. No tongue visible.
Invariants: retain identical full image framing, 1261 by 1247 canvas proportions, full seated character scale and position, head angle, mouth center, cheeks, chin, nose, eyebrows, open eyes, brown hair, clothing, body, hands, trousers and socks. No beautification, no cartoon red lips, no crop or zoom, no head motion.
Transparent background with preserved alpha. Full seated figure, no labels, text, grid, checkerboard or watermark.
